description: Verify NO mystery cubes (bare colored boxes) are visible anywhere in the scene. Catches logical/singleton entities (world_clock, free_camera, zone markers, spawners) that were authored without `visual: {hidden: true}` and fell through to entity_mesh_3d.gd's tier-3 fallback (default colored box at state.position).

params_schema.shot: wide_NE | wide_SW | wide_NW | wide_SE | overhead — which sanity-sweep vantage to use

framing.subject: full_level_visible
framing._doc: From a level corner at height 30-50m, pitch -0.4 to -0.6, looking toward the opposite corner. Captures the maximum scene area in one frame. Mystery cubes are small, but they're cubes — distinct silhouette against any natural scene.

prompt_template:
This wide capture shows the level from a corner vantage ({shot}). Camera at world {cam_pos}, looking-at level center.

Inspect the entire scene for MYSTERY CUBES — small, untextured, geometric box meshes that do NOT belong in the scene. These are NOT:
  - Authored structures (huts, walls, fences — those have material, doors, details)
  - Inventory props or items with intentional cube shapes

Mystery cubes are typically:
  - Pure flat-shaded colored boxes (no texture detail)
  - At positions like (0,0,0), (3,1.6,4), or other ad-hoc-looking coords
  - Cube proportions (roughly equal x/y/z)
  - Without surrounding context (no doors, no furniture, just floating geometry)

Answer:
  VERDICT: PASS | FAIL
  EVIDENCE: one sentence — if FAIL, describe the cube's approximate screen position. If PASS, confirm 'no mystery cubes visible'.
  CONFIDENCE: high | medium | low
common_fix: Locate the entity at the cube's approximate world coord (cross-reference state.position in level entities.json). Add `visual: {hidden: true}` to its def — see .claude/rules/data-demo.md § logical/singleton entities. The static validator validate_visual_presence.py catches this at sync time; this assertion is the visual confirm.
